criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Creative Work
categories.definition: A distinct artistic or intellectual creation, such as a film, album, book, or publication.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: A group of people with a particular purpose, such as a company, institution, or association.

categories.name: Populated Place
categories.definition: A named geographical location with a permanent or semi-permanent human settlement.

categories.name: Building or Structure
categories.definition: A constructed edifice or a significant man-made construction.

categories.name: Organism
categories.definition: A living being, including animals, plants, fungi, and microorganisms, or a taxonomic group thereof.

categories.name: Geographical Feature
categories.definition: A natural or artificial landform or body of water.

categories.name: Vehicle
categories.definition: A machine used for transporting people or goods.

categories.name: Educational Institution
categories.definition: An establishment providing education, such as a school, college, or university.

categories.name: Infrastructure
categories.definition: Fundamental facilities and systems serving a country, city, or area, such as transportation, communication, power, and water systems.

categories.name: Historic Site
categories.definition: A location or area designated for preservation due to its historical significance.
